description: Compares one voltage against eight thresholds and raises a gate for each threshold the voltage has reached

params.text: Sets that channel's threshold, -10V to +10V, added to the matching channel of the LEVELS input
Raises only the gate for the highest threshold the input has reached, instead of every gate at or below it; it does that in the position the maker's tooltip calls Off

inputs.text: Adds to the threshold knobs, one polyphonic channel per knob in order; a channel the cable does not reach adds nothing
The voltage compared against the eight thresholds; only the first channel of a cable is read

outputs.text: 10V while the input has reached that channel's threshold and 0V otherwise, or 10V only while that threshold is the highest one reached if the dot switch is set that way
The eight gates as an eight-channel polyphonic cable, one channel per threshold

notes: every threshold knob comes up at 0V, so on a fresh module all eight gates go high as soon as the input reaches 0V, which an empty jack already does.
a gate goes high when the input is level with its threshold, not only once it is past it.
in the dot setting at most one gate is high at a time, and none is high while the input is below every threshold.
the lamp beside a gate output lights while that gate is high.
where two thresholds are set to the same voltage the dot setting picks the earlier of the two.

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V on every channel.
inputs.1:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
